items.headline: Williams Reports Year-End 2014 Financial Results, Updates Guidance

evidence_method: A filed federal-court public-distribution table preserved by CourtListener RECAP supplies WMB's explicit first-public distribution clock. The exact issuer, release headline, and date are independently corroborated against the matching SEC Exhibit 99.1. WMB remains unresolved on the pinned base, satisfies SHA256(event_id)%5==2, and is not part of the active Worker-3 package. This branch is prep-only and leaves canonical fail-closed state unchanged.
integration_guard: Before canonical generation, the Worker-2 token holder must independently reopen the pinned filed court artifact, verify the WMB row, recheck exact-current-main unresolved/unclaimed state and SHA256(event_id)%5==2 ownership, regenerate only WMB through reserved batch 0102, and remove all prep-only artifacts before final PR. No EDGAR acceptance, conference-call, scheduled, inferred, date-only, archive-capture, or neighboring-release time may substitute.
